programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: This masterful film noir about five small-time crooks and a mysterious underworld crime boss enraptured audiences, earning a reputation as a "new classic."

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: When police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) learns that his childhood friend has become the prime suspect in a murder case, he also discovers that he's the only one who feels that his friend was framed to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Cutter's Way
programme.desc: Suspected of murder, Richard Bone (Jeff Bridges) turns to his best friend, Alex Cutter (John Heard), for help finding the real killer. But when their suspect turns the tables on them, a cunning game of cat-and-mouse ignites into a full-blown war!

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

programme.title: Hart's War
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge against the sleazy New York District Attorney (Gerald Gordon) who had set up the hit-gone-wrong.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: They don't need to see to steal! They're five unstoppable blind men. They can hear your heartbeat, smell your fear, and almost taste $15 million in secret CIA loot. Only one man stands in their way. He's the ultimate mercenary, and he doesn't know when to quit. They may be close to the perfect crime, but they'll never know what hit them.

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threatens to kill hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
programme.desc: Action superstar Charles Bronson is at his two-fisted best in this gritty thriller about a hardnosed vice cop who is hellbent on wiping out a child prostitution ring after an assault on his young daughter; taking vengeance into his own hands!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Remo Williams: The Adventure Begins
programme.desc: Brace yourself for an hilarious, action-packed adventure! When an NYPD cop (Fred Ward) regains consciousness after a mugging, he has a new identity! He's Remo Williams, a recruit of a top-secret organization, and he's toppling evil at every turn!

programme.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it’s swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they’re targets of the CIA! Crikey!

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: A special effects artist is hired by the Feds to stage the killing of a mob witness. But when the job is done, he’s pinned for the murder!

programme.title: F/X 2
programme.desc: Bryan Brown and Brian Dennehy are back for an all-new thriller that continues the F/X saga with unrelenting suspense and amazing high-tech action.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.
